Lab 1.title: Lab 1 — HTML Basics
Lab 1.description: Document structure, headings, emphasis, lists, images and relative links between pages.

Lab 2.title: Lab 2 — Tables, Forms & Semantic HTML
Lab 2.description: Semantic page structure, data tables with spanning cells, and interactive form controls.

Lab 3.title: Lab 3 — Elements, Layout & Forms
Lab 3.description: Block vs inline elements, `div` page layout, HTML entities, the HTML5 input types and the `output` element, plus a working contact page.

Lab 4.title: Lab 4 — CSS, Video & Navigation
Lab 4.description: Semantic HTML5 layout, an external and an internal style sheet, a CSS navigation bar, text-decoration, the four link states, an embedded `<video>`, a `<meter>` and a form — Problem A builds the Visit Terengganu page, Problem B debugs and extends e-Café Campus.

gallery.title: Validation Evidence
gallery.description: W3C markup validation results for the exercise pages.

Lab 1/lab1.html.title: About Me
Lab 1/lab1.html.description: Personal introduction with hobbies, favourite movies and an image element.

Lab 1/lab1_ExerA.html.title: Kopi Pantai Café
Lab 1/lab1_ExerA.html.description: Seaside café page using headings, `strong`, `em` and a description list.

Lab 1/lab1_ExerB.html.title: Campus Coding Club
Lab 1/lab1_ExerB.html.description: Thirteen markup errors identified and corrected, plus a two-page navigation bar.

Lab 1/contact.html.title: Contact Us
Lab 1/contact.html.description: Second page of the club site with committee members and contact details.

Lab 3/block.html.title: Block and Inline Elements
Lab 3/block.html.description: How block elements claim a whole line while inline elements stay inside the flow of the text.

Lab 3/div.html.title: Page Layout with div
Lab 3/div.html.description: Header, columns and footer built from `div` containers with inline background, width and float styles.

Lab 3/entity.html.title: HTML Entities
Lab 3/entity.html.description: Writing reserved characters — `<`, `>`, `©`, non-breaking space — by name and by number.

Lab 3/input5.html.title: HTML5 Input Types
Lab 3/input5.html.description: A tour of `color`, `date`, `range`, `email` and friends so the browser shows the right picker.

Lab 3/lab3.html.title: Contact Us — TechWeb Solutions
Lab 3/lab3.html.description: Div-based layout with an HTML5 contact form (`email`, `date`, `range`) and a live `output` sum calculator.

Lab 3/output5.html.title: The output Element
Lab 3/output5.html.description: A live addition machine that recalculates into `output` on every keystroke or slider move.

Lab 2/lab2.html.title: Personal Profile
Lab 2/lab2.html.description: Semantic layout combining a personal information table and a contact form.

Lab 2/Lab2_ExerA.html.title: FSKM Tech Day 2026
Lab 2/Lab2_ExerA.html.description: Event page with `header`, `nav`, `section` and `article` plus in-page anchors.

Lab 2/Lab2_ExerB.html.title: Course Feedback
Lab 2/Lab2_ExerB.html.description: Ten markup and accessibility errors fixed in a table-and-form feedback page.

Lab 2/semantic.html.title: Semantic HTML Example
Lab 2/semantic.html.description: Reference example of semantic elements replacing generic containers.

Lab 2/table.html.title: Working with Tables
Lab 2/table.html.description: Basic tables plus `colspan` for merged header and summary cells.

Lab 2/form.html.title: Creating Forms
Lab 2/form.html.description: Text inputs, radio buttons, checkboxes, select menu and submit button.

Lab 3/lab3_ExerA.html.title: CampusBake® — Online Order
Lab 3/lab3_ExerA.html.description: Five `div` sections, a HTML5 order form (`tel`, `email`, `date`, `time`, `color`, `range`, `datalist`) and a live `output` price total.

Lab 3/lab3_ExerB.html.title: Ticket Booking — Debug & Extend
Lab 3/lab3_ExerB.html.description: Thirteen deliberate errors found and fixed, then extended with a Now Showing sidebar, `tel`/`time` inputs and a second `output`.

Lab 3/inattribute5.html.title: HTML5 Input Attributes
Lab 3/inattribute5.html.description: `placeholder`, `autofocus`, `required` and `autocomplete` at work on a club sign-up form.

Lab 3/intro5_broken.html.title: Intro Page — broken version
Lab 3/intro5_broken.html.description: Deliberately invalid `<!DOCTYPE>` used to practise the validator; the errors it triggers are listed at the end of the file.

Lab 3/intro5.html.title: Introduction to HTML5
Lab 3/intro5.html.description: The corrected intro page — proper `<!DOCTYPE html>`, `lang`, UTF-8 charset — validating with no errors or warnings.

Lab 4/lab4_ExerA.html.title: Visit Terengganu — Tourism Page
Lab 4/lab4_ExerA.html.description: `header`/`nav`/three `section`s/`footer`, three destination `article`s with crossed-out prices, a seat `meter`, a captioned `<video>`, a `.trip-form` and all four link states — styled from `style.css` plus two page-only rules.

Lab 4/lab4_ExerB.html.title: e-Café Campus — Debug & Extend
Lab 4/lab4_ExerB.html.description: Fourteen faults in the given code found and listed by line number, then corrected and extended: `cafe.css`, a styled nav bar, `.old-price` line-through, a captioned video and a `.feedback-form`.
